name: Anlawdd Wledig
text: Anlawdd Wledig appears in the early Welsh tales. His name is said to mean ruler. He was the father of Eigr and also the grandfather of Culhwch. His child of Eigr became the mother of king Arthur of Wales.

attributes.attribute: father of Eigr and grandfather of Culhwch
